lines.say: You click buy. The order service calls payment directly.
lines.show: You click *buy.* The order service calls *payment* directly.

lines.say: And you wait until it's done.
Payment slows down, orders pile up, and the whole app goes down.
lines.show: Payment *slows down,* orders *pile up,* and the [whole app goes down.]

lines.say: The fix? Don't call payment directly. Put a message queue in the middle.
lines.show: The fix? Don't call payment *directly.* Put a [message queue] in the middle.

lines.say: Now the order service just drops your order in the queue, and tells you: order received.
lines.show: Now the order service just *drops* your order in the queue, and tells you: *order received.*

lines.say: On the other side, payment is the worker. It pulls orders out one at a time, at its own pace.
lines.show: On the other side, payment is the *worker.* It *pulls* orders out one at a time, at its *own pace.*

lines.say: Traffic spikes? The line just gets longer. Nothing crashes.
lines.show: Traffic spikes? The line just gets *longer.* [Nothing crashes.]

lines.say: Still too slow? Add more payment workers. They all pull from the same queue.
lines.show: Still too slow? Add more *payment workers.* They all pull from the *same queue.*

lines.say: And if a worker dies halfway? The queue only deletes an order once a worker says done.
lines.show: And if a worker *dies* halfway? The queue only deletes an order once a worker says *done.*

lines.say: Otherwise, it goes right back in line.
lines.show: Otherwise, it goes [right back in line.]

lines.say: That's what RabbitMQ and Amazon S-Q-S do.
Haven't seen retries? That reel's on my profile.
lines.show: Haven't seen *retries?* That reel's on my profile.

lines.show: If you're a *vibe coder,* follow for the system design your *AI skipped.*
